name: Evafresh Afterwash & Fabric Softener
tagline: Soft and fresh, wash after wash
shortDescription: Leaves clothes soft, easier to iron and fresh-smelling.
description: Add Evafresh Afterwash & Fabric Softener to your final rinse for softer clothes and towels that smell fresh for longer and are easier to iron.
ingredients: [PLACEHOLDER] Add the ingredient list exactly as printed on your label.
howToUse: Wash and rinse clothes as normal.
Add softener to the final rinse water (or machine softener drawer).
Soak for a few minutes, wring and dry.
safety: Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. Do not swallow.
